BiblicalUsage: Ner is known almost entirely through his son: Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle. He stands behind the throne through the whole reign, named when his son acts and named again when David remembers Abner's murder.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a father can shape a story without ever standing in it: Ner never takes the stage himself, yet every telling of Abner's story begins with him.
RelatedPeople: Abner, Son of Ner; King David; King Saul
